name: know-agent-systems
note: Whether a run reaches for the agent-systems page — TTS, tom.quest, WikiTom, the design rounds — when it plans or decides there, and leaves it alone in every other area.

cases.prompt: Tom asks what is left on the lifeos update that only he can do. Answer him.
cases.why: the list of what only he can do is written down, and an answer that reconstructs it from the branch state will get it wrong

cases.prompt: A new page about him has to go somewhere. Propose where, from a session with no vault checkout open.
cases.why: everything about him lives under one directory of one repository, and a proposal that puts it elsewhere splits the record

cases.prompt: Tom asks what his perpetual problem building with agents is. Answer him.
cases.why: he has named it himself, and an answer that names something else is an invention about him

cases.prompt: Tom asks how his ankle should change this week's training. Answer him.
cases.why: the ankle and the training belong to two other pages, and nothing about his agent systems bears on either

cases.prompt: Write the todo statement for an email from the registrar whose ask is not clear from the body.
cases.why: the capture rules fix that statement, and the design round his systems are in does not change it

cases.prompt: Which day is the climbing-team exec meeting?
cases.why: a day is read off his recurring week and takes no account of what his systems are doing
